why_isolated: The TSFM environment (.venv-tsfm) runs three verified foundation models on pinned package versions. AutoGluon pins pandas, numpy and torch ranges of its own, so installing it there would risk silently changing the models this closure must keep identical to the source study. Section 9 requires a separate environment.
base_interpreter: conda mlts python 3.11 (same as .venv-tsfm), fresh venv without system site packages
minimum_requirement: PatchTST, at least one of TiDE/DLinear, at least 3 distinct specialist families
metric_computation: fev native evaluator, reused from the existing .venv-tsfm; the specialist env only produces forecasts
handoff: specialist env writes quantile forecasts to runs/.../forecasts as npz; the TSFM env scores them with fev
on_block: SPECIALIST_ENV_BLOCKED -> INCONCLUSIVE_SPECIALIST_POWER; a single weak linear model will not be substituted to force a result
